official: 中野区行政手続条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 不利益処分の通知方法を見直す
summary: 不利益処分をしようとするとき、意見を述べる手続の通知方法として、区の事務所の掲示場への掲示が定められています。この議案で、規則で定める方法で不特定多数が閲覧できるようにしたうえ、区の事務所で書面を掲示するか、電子画面を閲覧できるようにします。公示の措置を始めてから2週間が経つと、通知が届いたものと扱います。
changes: 通知事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態に置く公示方法に改める
区の事務所で書面を掲示するか、電子画面を閲覧できるようにする
通知が届いたものと扱うまでの期間の起点を、公示の措置を始めた日に改める
who: 不利益処分の対象となり、意見陳述の手続に関する通知を受ける人
why: 行政手続法の改正に伴い、通知方法の規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises how notices of adverse dispositions are given
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nakano City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: When the ward plans to impose an adverse disposition, the prescribed way to notify people about the procedure for stating their views is to post a notice on a notice board at a ward office. Under this bill, the ward will make the notice details available for viewing by an unspecified number of people using a method set by rules, and then either post a written notice at a ward office or make it viewable on an electronic display. Once two weeks have passed since the public-notice measures began, the notice will be treated as having been received.
changes: Changes the public-notice method to make the notice details available for viewing by an unspecified number of people
Posts a written notice at a ward office or makes it viewable on an electronic display
Changes the starting point for the period before notice is treated as received to the day the public-notice measures begin
who: People who are subject to an adverse disposition and receive notice about the procedure for stating their views
en.why: The ward says this is to update the rules on notification methods in line with revisions to the Administrative Procedure Act.
